description.zh:
套餐类型。

- **sameflowcard**：同档位通用流量套餐。

- **directional_sameflowcard**：同档位定向流量套餐。
description.en:
The plan type. Valid values:

- **sameflowcard**: same-tier general traffic plan.

- **directional_sameflowcard**: same-tier directional traffic plan.

description.zh:
物联网卡的ICCID。

您可在物联网卡上查看ICCID，或者在[物联网SIM服务控制台](https://dyiotnext.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6a072d25p4pUg8)的卡管理页面查看ICCID。
description.en:
The ICCID of the IoT card.

You can view the ICCID on the IoT card or on the Card Management page of the [IoT SIM Service console](https://dyiotnext.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6a072d25p4pUg8).

descriptions.zh:
## 使用限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为20。

> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Limits

The maximum number of queries per second (QPS) per Alibaba Cloud account for invoking this operation is 20.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
